answer: Make every grader post a copper-sized bond and draw grading seats at random from the whole roster. A sybil swarm can't pick which answers its own puppets judge, so colluding raven-like flocks rarely land together; each fake identity must lock its own bond, and any grade that strays far from the honest consensus gets slashed. Faking a crowd means funding hundreds of bonds and losing them, so no cheap oasis of free votes appears.
